cells: Chairman not eligible for further employment under Government
Service conditions cannot be varied to disadvantage

blocks.content: The conditions of service of a member shall not be varied to his disadvantage after his appointment.

items: State Public Service Commission (SPSC) members are appointed by the Governor but can ONLY be removed by the President of India.
Salaries, allowances, and pensions of constitutional appointees are charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India and are non-votable.
A retiring UPSC member is eligible for appointment as the Chairman of UPSC or SPSC, but is strictly barred from any other government employment.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Appointments to key constitutional bodies are made directly by the President of India by warrant under hand and seal.
The standard tenure of office is fixed for a period of six years or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
Conditions of service determined prior to appointment cannot be varied to the appointee's disadvantage during their term.
To ensure independence and impartiality, officers are ineligible for further employment under the Central or State governments after demitting office.
Removal from office can only occur on constitutional grounds such as proved misbehaviour or incapacity following an inquiry by the Supreme Court.
